import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    private static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static class FieldElement {
        private long val;

        public FieldElement(long v) {
            val = v % MOD;
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
            if (val >= MOD) {
                System.err.println("FieldElement overflow!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
        }

        public long get() {
            return val;
        }

        public FieldElement add(FieldElement o) {
            return new FieldElement((val + o.val) % MOD);
        }

        public FieldElement subtract(FieldElement o) {
            return new FieldElement((val - o.val + MOD) % MOD);
        }

        public FieldElement multiply(FieldElement o) {
            return new FieldElement((val * o.val) % MOD);
        }

        public FieldElement divide(FieldElement o) {
            return multiply(o.inverse());
        }

        public FieldElement addInPlace(FieldElement o) {
            val = (val + o.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public FieldElement subtractInPlace(FieldElement o) {
            val = (val - o.val + MOD) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public FieldElement multiplyInPlace(FieldElement o) {
            val = (val * o.val) % MOD;
            return this;
        }

        public FieldElement divideInPlace(FieldElement o) {
            return multiplyInPlace(o.inverse());
        }

        public FieldElement inverse() {
            long exp = MOD - 2;
            long base = val;
            long res = 1;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    res = (res * base) % MOD;
                }
                base = (base * base) % MOD;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return new FieldElement(res);
        }
    }

    static FieldElement[][] matmul(FieldElement[][] A, FieldElement[][] B) {
        int rowsA = A.length;
        int colsA = A[0].length;
        int rowsB = B.length;
        int colsB = B[0].length;
        if (colsA != rowsB) {
            System.err.println("Matrix multiplication dimension mismatch!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        FieldElement[][] result = new FieldElement[rowsA][colsB];
        for (int i = 0; i < rowsA; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < colsB; ++j) {
                result[i][j] = new FieldElement(0);
                for (int k = 0; k < colsA; ++k) {
                    result[i][j] = result[i][j].add(A[i][k].multiply(B[k][j]));
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static FieldElement[] matvecmul(FieldElement[][] A, FieldElement[] v) {
        int rows = A.length;
        int cols = A[0].length;
        if (v.length != cols) {
            System.err.println("Matrix-vector dimension mismatch!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        FieldElement[] result = new FieldElement[rows];
        for (int i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {
            result[i] = new FieldElement(0);
            for (int j = 0; j < cols; ++j) {
                result[i] = result[i].add(A[i][j].multiply(v[j]));
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static FieldElement[][] make2D(int r, int c) {
        FieldElement[][] arr = new FieldElement[r][c];
        for (int i = 0; i < r; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < c; ++j) {
                arr[i][j] = new FieldElement(0);
            }
        }
        return arr;
    }

    static FieldElement[][][] make3D(int d1, int d2, int d3) {
        FieldElement[][][] arr = new FieldElement[d1][d2][d3];
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < d2; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < d3; ++k) {
                    arr[i][j][k] = new FieldElement(0);
                }
            }
        }
        return arr;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        FieldElement[][][] shifts = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; ++i) {
                shifts[k][i][(i + k) % d] = new FieldElement(1);
            }
            shifts[k][d][d] = new FieldElement(1);
        }

        FieldElement[][][] units = make3D(d, d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k < d; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                units[k][i][i] = new FieldElement(1);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
                units[k][k][i] = new FieldElement(1);
            }
        }

        FieldElement[][] I = make2D(d + 1, d + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
            I[i][i] = new FieldElement(1);
        }

        Map<Long, FieldElement[][]> memo = new HashMap<>();

        class MatrixBuilder {
            public FieldElement[][] buildMatrix(long p) {
                if (memo.containsKey(p)) {
                    return memo.get(p);
                }
                if (p <= d) {
                    FieldElement[][] M = I;
                    for (int k = 0; k < (int) p; ++k) {
                        M = matmul(units[k], M);
                    }
                    memo.put(p, M);
                    return M;
                }
                long block = d;
                while ((p + block - 1) / block > d) {
                    block *= d;
                }
                FieldElement[][] child = buildMatrix(block);
                FieldElement[][] M = child;
                long rem = p - block;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; ++k) {
                    if (rem >= block) {
                        M = matmul(matmul(matmul(shifts[d - k], child), shifts[k]), M);
                        rem -= block;
                    } else if (rem > 0) {
                        M = matmul(matmul(matmul(shifts[d - k], buildMatrix(rem)), shifts[k]), M);
                        rem = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                memo.put(p, M);
                return M;
            }
        }

        MatrixBuilder builder = new MatrixBuilder();
        FieldElement[][] M = builder.buildMatrix(n);
        FieldElement[] base = new FieldElement[d + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i < d + 1; ++i) {
            base[i] = new FieldElement(0);
        }
        base[d] = new FieldElement(1);
        FieldElement[] resVec = matvecmul(M, base);
        FieldElement total = new FieldElement(0);
        for (FieldElement x : resVec) {
            total = total.add(x);
        }
        System.out.println(total.get());
    }
}
